event_chain.summary: Account used to send phishing in chief name

summary: In September 2026 Duquesne (Pennsylvania) Police Chief Tom Shaw's email account was compromised and used to send a fraudulent phishing email asking recipients to review attached documents. Shaw learned of it when his daughter asked about the message; the account received thousands of replies before the message was recognized as fraudulent.
